title: work:pr commits carry the attribution trailer
goal: Every commit work:pr makes carries the same attribution lines as the agent's own commits
acceptance: Failing-first fixture tests: --trailer and HARNESS_COMMIT_TRAILER lines end every commit work:pr makes; with neither, the branch's newest commit's Co-Authored-By trailers are carried over; a malformed trailer is refused before anything is written
pull-requests.md names the option; patch release tagged after a confirmed merge
privacy: Tool text only; fixtures use invented names; no personal data.
escalation: A trailer that names a person is the project's choice; the tool never invents one

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25 at agent speed: one commit helper, its CLI option, fixture tests and a patch release. Not a measurement.
